cor:cancellation.cautions: Nonrationality imports the separate one-stabilization theorem; the level-two rationality theorem alone does not prove the threshold.
cor:cancellation.conclusion: The two explicit cubic threefolds have threshold two and yield nonrational Y with rational Y times A1.
cor:cancellation.hypotheses: X is either displayed smooth Tschinkel--Zhang cubic threefold.
cor:cancellation.objects: The stabilization threshold and Y=X times P1.

cor:cubics.cautions: This is restricted to the two Tschinkel--Zhang families, not every smooth cubic hypersurface.
cor:cubics.conclusion: X times P2 is rational over Q.
cor:cubics.hypotheses: X belongs to Tschinkel--Zhang Proposition 5.1 or 5.2.
cor:cubics.objects: Cubic hypersurfaces fibred by quartic del Pezzo surfaces.

prop:slice.cautions: The subgroup classification is complete only for the four hereditary-H1 types; no classification of all W(D5) subgroups is claimed.
prop:slice.conclusion: A good codimension-three tangent slice exists geometrically and descends on every twist of the four types.
prop:slice.hypotheses: The Cox parameters lie on the smooth open and the Galois image has type I0, I1, I2, or I3.
prop:slice.objects: The saturated rank-three subtorus, boundary space, and tangent-frame incidence.

rem:saturation.cautions: The degree-two artifact belongs to the parameter isogeny, not the Rosenlicht quotient.
rem:saturation.conclusion: Adjoining the half-sum saturates the lattice and removes the projective mu_2 kernel.
rem:saturation.hypotheses: The three pairwise-sign cocharacters are used in the last three coordinates.
rem:saturation.objects: An index-two even-sum cocharacter sublattice and its saturation.

thm:level-two.cautions: Universal-torsor rationality and the four-type classification are imported from Tschinkel--Zhang.
thm:level-two.conclusion: S times A2 is k-rational; this applies in particular to stably rational S.
thm:level-two.hypotheses: Characteristic zero, S smooth quartic del Pezzo, S(k) nonempty, and geometric Picard lattice stably permutation.
thm:level-two.objects: A quartic del Pezzo surface and two-dimensional affine stabilization.

thm:window.cautions: A merely finite-index weight simplex would give a finite orbit cover and does not suffice.
thm:window.conclusion: The Rosenlicht quotient Z/T is k-rational.
thm:window.hypotheses: Generically free rank-r torus action, tangent-projection property, descended boundary, unimodular r-simplex of weights, and a nondegenerate tangent slice.
thm:window.objects: A torus action on a projective variety with a unimodular surviving weight window.
